U10:ACT.drill: Pull Open / Pull the V, pass & sprint
U10:ACT.objective: Learn to turn and pass, then sprint to the next station.
U10:ACT.success: The pass reaches the waiting player and the passer sprints through the change of direction to the red cone.

U10:D1.objective: Learn to protect the mini-goal while closing down the receiver.
U10:D1.success: The defender blocks the route towards the mini-goal and gets close enough to challenge the ball.

U10:D2.objective: Learn to close the return pass with a teammate covering the middle.
U10:D2.success: The first defender closes the return pass and a teammate blocks a pass through the middle.

U11:D2.objective: Learn to protect the middle together as the goalkeeper plays to either side.
U11:D2.success: The nearest defender slows the receiver down and a teammate blocks the pass through the middle.

U12:D2.objective: Learn to protect the middle together as the goalkeeper plays to either side.
U12:D2.success: The nearest defender slows the receiver down and a teammate blocks the pass through the middle.

U6:ACT.objective: Learn to turn with Pull Open and pass to the next player.
U6:ACT.success: The player keeps the ball within reach after Pull Open and passes to the waiting player.

U6:D2.objective: Learn to close the way back to the goalkeeper as the receiver takes the ball.
U6:D2.success: The defender makes a curved run to block the pass back to the keeper and slows down close to the ball.

U7:ACT.objective: Learn to turn with Pull Open and pass to the next player.
U7:ACT.success: The player keeps the ball within reach after Pull Open and passes to the waiting player.

U7:D1.objective: Learn to close the return pass as the goalkeeper plays to a teammate.
U7:D1.success: The defender blocks the return pass and gets close enough to challenge the receiver.

U7:D2.objective: Learn to press the receiver with a teammate covering the next pass.
U7:D2.success: The first defender closes the return pass while a teammate covers the next forward option.

U8:D1.objective: Learn to close the return pass as the goalkeeper plays to a teammate.

U5:ACT.objective: Learn to pull the ball back and turn into free space.
U5:ACT.success: The player turns away from the cone and keeps the ball within reach.

U5:D1.objective: Learn to move towards an opponent with the ball and try to steal it.
U5:D1.success: The defender moves towards the attacker and tries to steal the ball.

U5:D2.objective: Learn to make a curved run to press the next attacker after shooting.
U5:D2.success: After the shot, [G9] makes a curved run and slows down close to [R3].
